actions.name: Use
actions.area: 20 ft.-radius spread centered on the caster

description.summary: The caster emulates the wisp’s ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle
description.value: The caster emulates the wisp’s ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle. The caster creates a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper. A creature can resist this compulsion by making a successful Will save. Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered for the duration of this spell. Once a creature makes the save against this spell, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that caster for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Learned From Wisp family
